summary: Plan, spec, and committed strategy (7fe1a95) validated against the shipped surface. All 19 plan tasks are bounded, independently verifiable, scoped away from controlled_harness_evolution_20260714 Phase S1 (the versioned manifest, hash-drift detection, and preflight work are explicitly deferred), and free of anti-patterns A3 (bare integer findings) and A7 (relaxing assertions). Live-state reconciliation at the strategy commit SHA confirms: agent count is 27 (callable 25) — matches the strategy's reconciliation; unmapped models total 3 (measure-adversarial-testing → deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro, measure-ux-browser-review → xiaomi/mimo-v2.5, coder-openai-gpt-5-6-luna-fast → openai/gpt-5.6-luna-fast), not the 8 claimed by the original spec — recorded as deviation_notes in metadata.json. Contract test layout covers three new test files (tests/parity.test.mjs, tests/model-resolution.test.mjs, tests/green-gate.test.mjs), one rewrite of tests/core.test.mjs (remove frozen 24/22 snapshot, assert derived contract and reachable unmappedModels predicate), one new classifier file (tests/.track-red-files.txt), and one new package script (scripts/test-shipped.mjs wired as `npm run test:shipped`). Fixtures live under tests/fixtures/{parity,model-resolution,green-gate}/ as self-contained synthetic input, all A3 defenses probe labeled-integer parsing (analog to tests/manifest.test.mjs#agentCountLabel) and the A7 analog defends the green-gate's exclude filter via a not-actually-red.test.mjs probe. UX/browser review applicability: not_applicable across all three phases (no HTML/CSS/JSX/web surface in the package). No plan edits required — the strategy commit (7fe1a95) already records the spec-vs-live reconciliation and the corrected task count.
plan_updates: no edits — committed strategy revision (7fe1a95) already records the spec-vs-live discrepancy in metadata.json#deviation_notes, rewrites Task 1.2 (A3 labeled-integer parse) and Task 2.4 (live unmapped-model count = 3, not 8), and names the contract test surface and green-gate architecture in the plan's Contract Test Layout section

Spec text describes an earlier state; strategy's metadata.json#deviation_notes and Task 2.4 reconcile against live behavior. Mid/Jr must reconcile against the live roster, not the spec's frozen count.

Phase 1 and Phase 2 Green gates run before Phase 3 ships `npm run test:shipped`. Until Phase 3 Green lands, the canonical Green gate is `npm test` exiting 0 modulo the four S1 intentional-Red files. This is documented in strategy §1 (gate configuration) and the Phase 1/2 Green gate descriptions; not a defect, but a known ordering consequence Mid/Jr must internalize.

Task 2.4 escalates the routing choice for three unmapped models to the user. Per spec 'Out of Scope: Changing which model any agent is routed to. Correcting the roster's model references is a separate decision requiring the user's routing intent.' Mid and Jr must not unilaterally decide routing; reconciliation report classifies each as map_entry_needed or reference_incorrect based on provider/id shape.
